xUnit: fractions of the way from home to the landing spot (0.62 character widths in front of the target)
note: The fire slime's Magma Slam path: it stays home through the crouch, leaves the floor in frame 3, crosses most of the way while rising and at the top of the leap (frames 4 and 5), is nearly there when it falls (6), lands on the landing spot at the start of frame 7 (the splat, the hit frame) and stays there for the rebound (8); the page then slides it home. The height of the leap (about 160 px at the top in the 512 px cell) is drawn in the strip.
